# Algebra Readiness Misconception Sort

Subject: Intervention
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Diagnostic Sort
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation Mathematics Learning Standards

## Short Description
A quick sort for identifying misconceptions with variables, inverse operations, and equation balance.

## Alignment Note
Supports targeted reteaching for pre-algebra and Algebra I readiness skills.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after a preassessment to form short reteach groups.

## Preview Content
- Misconception: equals means answer comes next
- Evidence to look for
- Reteach move

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
